what: A fixed header floating over photos (logo, MENU, booking circle) switches from light text to ink color over .5s ease when it falls inside the band of a light section (data-ink), running from the section head reaching 70% of the screen to the section tail reaching 70%. Once it leaves the band it turns light again. If bands of several sections overlap, it stays ink as long as it is inside any one. Inner lines, borders and icons change together via currentColor

options.sections: Selector for the light sections to turn ink-black, default [data-ink]
options.start: Band start line, default top 70% — set per section with data-ink-start
options.end: Band end line, default bottom 70% — set per section with data-ink-end
options.narrow: At window widths at or below this (px), data-ink-start-narrow and data-ink-end-narrow are used (original phone: top center → bottom center), default 800
options.--fx-light: Text color over the photo (via style), default var(--kf-contrast-ink)
options.--fx-ink: Text color on light sections (via style), default var(--kf-ink)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Background-painted line (burger lines etc., optional) — painted in the text color
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Outline-only circle/pill (optional) — the border follows the text color
